_why: Canonical settings for every reported result, committed next to the numbers.
This file exists because two runs were compared that differed in four
fields rather than one. train_predictor.py defaults to --pca-dim 0, but
every original result was produced with --pca-dim 128 passed by hand. The
divergence lived only in shell history, so a later run that omitted it
looked comparable and was not -- see ledger L7.
Rule: a number quoted in results.md names the config block that produced
it. Before comparing two runs, diff them: scripts/diff_checkpoints.py.

default._note: stride = (chunk - 2*margin)/tubelet = 8 latents, which stamps a period-8 comb into simulated latents. Real video is unaffected. See ledger L6.

comb_free._note: Maximum overlap. Reduces but does not eliminate the comb, and costs roughly 8x. Use for anything that compares sim against real.

pca128._note: The setting behind every original E3 number. PCA concentrates the low-rank comb into the retained directions, so the artifact matters MORE here than at full width -- 0.887 combed vs 0.832 comb-free.

full._note: Full 1024-d. Direction cosine is far lower here (~0.69) than under PCA (~0.88) for the same data -- the two are NOT comparable. The comb is nearly irrelevant at this width: 0.692 combed vs 0.695 comb-free.

e3_horizon._caveat: combed; gain figures carry a period-8 sawtooth

real_data._caveat: real latents have no comb, so 'default' is clean here

sim_vs_real._caveat: the only pairing in which the comparison is valid
